newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial completes year-end audit.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial completes year-end audit.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Monday it completed its year-end audit, ending the year with about $118 million of cash and cash equivalents on its balance sheet.

"With the current turmoil in the markets concerning companies in the automobile finance business, we wanted to assure our shareholders that Olympic has completed its year-end audit process and publicly provided full information with respect to its business," Richard Greenawalt, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.

Mercury Finance Co recently disclosed that it overstated its earnings by about $90 million over the last four years, due to accounting discrepancies. Mercury is currently in default and negotiating with its lenders to obtain short-term financing to stabilize the company.

Commenting on Olympic Financial's drop in its share price, Greenawalt said, "We know of no reason to explain the precipitous decline in our stock price, other than the troubles affecting other auto finance companies."
Olympic Financial shares were up 3/4 at 10-5/8. Olympic Financial closed Friday down 1-7/8 at 9-7/8.

"We have had discussions with our key sources of warehousing funding and credit enhancement, including Bank of America (BankAmerica Corp ), J.P. Morgan (& Co Inc), and Financial Security Assurance Inc," Greenawalt said. "Based upon these discussions we will continue to have access to these credit facilities, credit enhancements and the continued support of these institutions."

Olympic Financial previously announced a tender offer for its $145 million of outstanding 13 percent senior notes due 2000. Olympic. After consulting with Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, the dealer-manager, has confirmed it intends to proceed with the tender offer.

In addition, the company previously announced it intends to offer up to $300 million of new senior notes to fund the tender offer and provide additional capital to expand its business. Olympic said it confirmed that it intends to proceed with these plans.
